stem.text: Which statement is correct about the number of telomeres present in prophase of a human body cell?

A.text: 46 as there is one telomere at the end of 46 chromosomes

B.text: 92 as there is one telomere at each end of 46 chromosomes

C.text: 92 as there is one telomere at the end of 92 chromatids

D.text: 184 as there is one telomere at each end of 92 chromatids
